# mtncloud_apps (Data Source)

Lists your apps, including those made in the console. An app groups instances deployed together from a blueprint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only those whose name matches; leave name_regex out to list them all.
data "mtncloud_apps" "all" {
  name_regex = "^web-"
}

output "apps" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_apps.all.apps : x.id => { name = x.name, name = x.name } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_status` (String) Only list apps whose `app_status` is this (case ignored).
- `blueprint` (String) Only list apps whose `blueprint` is this (case ignored).
- `environment` (String) Only list apps whose `environment` is this (case ignored).
- `group` (String) Only list apps whose `group` is this (case ignored).
- `labels` (List of String) Only list apps that have every one of these `labels` (case ignored).
- `name_regex` (String) Only return apps whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `owner` (String) Only list apps whose `owner` is this (case ignored).
- `status` (String) Only list apps whose `status` is this (case ignored).
- `type` (String) Only list apps whose `type` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) The apps, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `app_status` (String) Deployment status, for example `completed`.
- `blueprint` (String) Blueprint the app was deployed from, or empty.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `environment` (String) Environment, for example `dev`, or empty.
- `group` (String) Group the app belongs to.
- `id` (Number) ID of the app.
- `instance_count` (Number) Number of instances.
- `instances` (List of Number) IDs of the app's instances.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
- `name` (String) Name of the app.
- `owner` (String) Username of the app's owner.
- `status` (String) Status, for example `running`.
- `type` (String) Blueprint type the app was deployed from.
